name: bottle weighted straight legs deadlift
description: A near-straight-leg deadlift with bottles in your hands. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight, with a tiny knee bend.
Hinge forward, sliding the bottles down your legs.
Stop when you feel a firm hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
